dialogues.jp: うららかな春の日の午後。
dialogues.en: It's a warm spring afternoon.
dialogues.text: It's a warm spring afternoon.

dialogues.jp: 俺は居間で粗大ゴミになっていた。
dialogues.en: I'm a lump of trash in the living room.
dialogues.text: I'm a lump of trash in the living room.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「どっか出かけてきたら？」
dialogues.en: "Why don't you go out?"
dialogues.text: "Why don't you go out?"

dialogues.jp:
こぽこぽ、と最近ひきこもり化している音夢が
お茶をいれながら首をかしげた。
dialogues.en:
Nemu tilts her head as she pours tea in the cup. She's been
stuck inside the house for days.
dialogues.text:
Nemu tilts her head as she pours tea in the cup. She's been
stuck inside the house for days.

dialogues.jp:
調子がいいように見えるが、微熱はひかないし、
家の外に出るとすぐに咳き込む始末である。
dialogues.en:
She looks better but she still has a mild fever. So when she
goes outside, she starts coughing.
dialogues.text:
She looks better but she still has a mild fever. So when she
goes outside, she starts coughing.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、いい……今週は疲れた」
dialogues.en: "No thanks. I'm tired enough this week."
dialogues.text: "No thanks. I'm tired enough this week."

dialogues.jp: ソファーに深く背を預けて呟く。
dialogues.en: I mumble after settling down on the couch.
dialogues.text: I mumble after settling down on the couch.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そういう時こそ外を散歩とかしてくるといい
　のに」
dialogues.en: "That's why you need to go for a walk or something."
dialogues.text: "That's why you need to go for a walk or something."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うるさいな……かったるいんだよ……」
dialogues.en: "Can you stop it? I'm exhausted."
dialogues.text: "Can you stop it? I'm exhausted."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、あのさくらが先生だもんね」
dialogues.en: "Well, I suppose so, because Sakura is your teacher now."
dialogues.text: "Well, I suppose so, because Sakura is your teacher now."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あれは珍獣だ珍獣」
dialogues.en: "I guarantee you she's an exotic animal."
dialogues.text: "I guarantee you she's an exotic animal."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ち、珍獣ってね……」
dialogues.en: "Exotic animal...?"
dialogues.text: "Exotic animal...?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あ、そういえば音夢、さくらに勉強でも見て
　もらうか？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, Nemu. Why don't you ask Sakura to be a tutor for you?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, Nemu. Why don't you ask Sakura to be a tutor for you?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「科目と要点をまとめてもらえば、復学したと
　きに置いていかれずにすむだろ」
dialogues.en:
"If she can sort out the points in each subject, you could
catch up in class easily when you come back to school."
dialogues.text:
"If she can sort out the points in each subject, you could
catch up in class easily when you come back to school."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いいよ、自分でも勉強はしてるし、さくらだっ
　て毎日授業やって疲れてるよ」
dialogues.en:
"Don't worry. I've been studying by myself, and she must be
tired from teaching every day."
dialogues.text:
"Don't worry. I've been studying by myself, and she must be
tired from teaching every day."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……お前、家で勉強してるのか？」
dialogues.en: "...Are you studying at home?"
dialogues.text: "...Are you studying at home?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うん。３時間くらい」
dialogues.en: "Yes. I've been doing it for about three hours each day."
dialogues.text: "Yes. I've been doing it for about three hours each day."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「面倒だな……」
dialogues.en: "Oh, come on..."
dialogues.text: "Oh, come on..."

dialogues.jp: ため息まじりに天井を見上げて｛うめ／呻｝く。
dialogues.en: I mutter, looking up the ceiling with a sigh.
dialogues.text: I mutter, looking up the ceiling with a sigh.

dialogues.jp: と、玄関のチャイムが鳴る。
dialogues.en: Suddenly, the doorbell rings.
dialogues.text: Suddenly, the doorbell rings.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、はーい」
dialogues.en: "Coming!"
dialogues.text: "Coming!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いいよ、俺が行く」
dialogues.en: "I'll get it."
dialogues.text: "I'll get it."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「別にゆっくりしてればいいのに」
dialogues.en: "You take it easy."
dialogues.text: "You take it easy."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そのカッコで来た人間を喜ばすのか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you think a visitor will like your outfit?"
dialogues.text: "Do you think a visitor will like your outfit?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「え、うわ！　なに見てるのよ！」
dialogues.en: "What? Oh my God! Don't look!"
dialogues.text: "What? Oh my God! Don't look!"

dialogues.jp: シャツの｛すそ／裾｝をおさえて音夢が身をひく。
dialogues.en: Nemu steps back, tugging the edge of the shirt.
dialogues.text: Nemu steps back, tugging the edge of the shirt.

dialogues.jp: 「今更だろうが……」
dialogues.en: "It's not new to me, anyway."
dialogues.text: "It's not new to me, anyway."

dialogues.jp:
呟くが、そういえば音夢のシャツの絶対防衛線
が破られたことはなかったか。
dialogues.en:
I've never seen Nemu wearing a shirt that's indecent like
that.
dialogues.text:
I've never seen Nemu wearing a shirt that's indecent like
that.

dialogues.jp: 「このまま部屋に帰っちまおうかな」
dialogues.en: "I wanna go back to my room, though."
dialogues.text: "I wanna go back to my room, though."

dialogues.jp: 頭をかいて玄関に向かう。
dialogues.en: I walk to the front door, scratching my head.
dialogues.text: I walk to the front door, scratching my head.

dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おっはよんよん！」
dialogues.en: "Gooood morning!"
dialogues.text: "Gooood morning!"

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「うなー」
dialogues.en: "Meow!"
dialogues.text: "Meow!"

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「雨は降ってないか」
dialogues.en: "Is it raining?"
dialogues.text: "Is it raining?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ、なにやってる？」
dialogues.en: "Hm? What are you doing?"
dialogues.text: "Hm? What are you doing?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「……お前がチャイムを鳴らすなんて、なんか
　悪いモンでも食ったか？」
dialogues.en: "You can't be feeling well, to ring the door bell."
dialogues.text: "You can't be feeling well, to ring the door bell."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ？」
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「にゃー」
dialogues.en: "Meow..."
dialogues.text: "Meow..."

dialogues.jp:
さくらを真似て頭の上の猫も首をかしげようと
するが、足場がそもそも斜めなのでずれ落ちか
ける。
dialogues.en:
The cat on her head tries to cock her head like Sakura, but
she almost falls off.
dialogues.text:
The cat on her head tries to cock her head like Sakura, but
she almost falls off.

dialogues.jp: 「で、どうした？」
dialogues.en: "So, what's up?"
dialogues.text: "So, what's up?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あのねあのねあのねあのね！　今日は日曜日
　なんだよ日曜日！」
dialogues.en:
"Listen, listen, listen!! It's Sunday today, do you know
that?"
dialogues.text:
"Listen, listen, listen!! It's Sunday today, do you know
that?"

dialogues.jp: ぶんぶん、と拳を振りながらまくしたてる。
dialogues.en: She talks fast while spinning her fist.
dialogues.text: She talks fast while spinning her fist.

dialogues.jp: 「用件を言え」
dialogues.en: "What do you want?"
dialogues.text: "What do you want?"

dialogues.jp:
日曜日に子供に遊園地に行きたいとせがまれる、
父親の気分を味わう。
dialogues.en:
The little kid begs me to go to the amusement park on
Sunday.I feel like a father.
dialogues.text:
The little kid begs me to go to the amusement park on
Sunday.I feel like a father.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「今日は先生じゃないから、お兄ちゃんに甘え
　に来たの♪」
dialogues.en: "I'm not a teacher today, so I'm a spoiled child of yours."
dialogues.text: "I'm not a teacher today, so I'm a spoiled child of yours."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そりゃ難儀だな」
dialogues.en: "What an ordeal."
dialogues.text: "What an ordeal."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「後ね、初お給料日前だからなんかショッピン
　グに行こうと思って」
dialogues.en:
"Also, I want to go shopping, because I'm getting paid
soon."
dialogues.text:
"Also, I want to go shopping, because I'm getting paid
soon."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「その報告か」
dialogues.en: "That's why you're here?"
dialogues.text: "That's why you're here?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「一緒に行こうって言ってるんだよ」
dialogues.en: "I'm asking you to come with me."
dialogues.text: "I'm asking you to come with me."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ、悪い、音夢の体調がよくなくてさ」
dialogues.en: "Umm... sorry, but Nemu isn't feeling well today."
dialogues.text: "Umm... sorry, but Nemu isn't feeling well today."

dialogues.jp: 思わず声をひそめてしまう。
dialogues.en: I lower my voice unconsciously.
dialogues.text: I lower my voice unconsciously.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ……そうなの？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, really?"
dialogues.text: "Oh, really?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あいついつも独りだろ、日曜日くらい一緒に
　居てやろうと思って」
dialogues.en:
"She always stays at home by herself during the week, so I
want to keep her company on Sunday at least."
dialogues.text:
"She always stays at home by herself during the week, so I
want to keep her company on Sunday at least."

dialogues.jp: 小言はうるさいが、まぁ、そんなものだ。
dialogues.en: That's all I needed to say.
dialogues.text: That's all I needed to say.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ねぇ、お兄ちゃん。もし、もしだよ」
dialogues.en: "Hey, oniichan. What if... I mean if..."
dialogues.text: "Hey, oniichan. What if... I mean if..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「お兄ちゃんの大好きな子がふたりいて、その
　どちらかがいなくなるとして……お兄ちゃん
　が失うほうを選べるとしたら……」
dialogues.en:
"If you had two lovely children, and one of them has to
disappear. Then, which one do you think you'd let go?"
dialogues.text:
"If you had two lovely children, and one of them has to
disappear. Then, which one do you think you'd let go?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「その片方が音夢ちゃんだったら、もうひとり
　はどのくらい大切じゃないといけないかな？」
dialogues.en:
"If one of them was Nemu-chan, then, how important would the
other one have to be for you?"
dialogues.text:
"If one of them was Nemu-chan, then, how important would the
other one have to be for you?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……なんだその質問は」
dialogues.en: "What are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "What are you talking about?"

dialogues.jp:
また、日曜の午後に破壊力の高い質問をされる
ものだ。
dialogues.en:
I can't believe she asked me such an intimidating question
on Sunday afternoon.
dialogues.text:
I can't believe she asked me such an intimidating question
on Sunday afternoon.

dialogues.jp:
「相手しだいだろうが。そもそも、ふたりとも
　守ることが本当に出来ないか考えるのが先だ
　ろう」
dialogues.en:
"It depends on who the other one is. But first, I would
think how I can save both of them at once."
dialogues.text:
"It depends on who the other one is. But first, I would
think how I can save both of them at once."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうだよね」
dialogues.en: "You're right."
dialogues.text: "You're right."

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ……」
dialogues.en: "Meow..."
dialogues.text: "Meow..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あ、うたまるお腹すいたの？　仕方ない、そ
　れじゃ帰ろうか？」
dialogues.en: "Oh, are you hungry, Utamaru? Let's go home now."
dialogues.text: "Oh, are you hungry, Utamaru? Let's go home now."

dialogues.jp:
明らかな作り笑いを浮かべてさくらが帰ろうと
する。
dialogues.en: Sakura tries to leave, making an obviously fake smile.
dialogues.text: Sakura tries to leave, making an obviously fake smile.

dialogues.jp: 「おい」
dialogues.en: "Hey."
dialogues.text: "Hey."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ、なにかな？」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, what?"
dialogues.text: "Yeah, what?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「さっきの質問だけど……」
dialogues.en: "About the question you asked..."
dialogues.text: "About the question you asked..."

dialogues.jp:
頬をかいて視線を逸らす。どうにも、女子供に
は弱いな俺は。
dialogues.en:
I look away scratching my cheek. How vulnerable I am to
girls and children.
dialogues.text:
I look away scratching my cheek. How vulnerable I am to
girls and children.

dialogues.jp: 「もうひとりがお前だったら選べないな」
dialogues.en: "If the other one is you, I couldn't choose."
dialogues.text: "If the other one is you, I couldn't choose."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ！？」
電気でも走ったみたいに身体が震えた。
dialogues.en: Her body trembles as if she got an electric shock.
dialogues.text: Her body trembles as if she got an electric shock.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「えへへへへへへへへへへへへへ♪」
dialogues.en: "Teeheeheeheehee......!"
dialogues.text: "Teeheeheeheehee......!"

dialogues.jp:
とろとろ、と本気で頬が落ちそうなくらいの表
情をさくらが浮かべる。
dialogues.en: Sakura smiles so widely, I thought her head would fall off.
dialogues.text: Sakura smiles so widely, I thought her head would fall off.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「えへへへへへへへへへへへへへへへへへへへ
　へへへへへへへへへへへへ……♪」
dialogues.en: "Teeheeheeheeheeheeheeheehee...!"
dialogues.text: "Teeheeheeheeheeheeheeheehee...!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「帰れ帰れ！」
dialogues.en: "Get going!!"
dialogues.text: "Get going!!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うん、ボク帰る〜♪」
dialogues.en: "Yep, I am!"
dialogues.text: "Yep, I am!"

dialogues.jp:
酒に酔ったみたいに足元危なっかしく、さくら
が去っていく。
dialogues.en: Sakura walks away, wobbling as if she were a drunk.
dialogues.text: Sakura walks away, wobbling as if she were a drunk.

dialogues.jp: 「まったく……甘いな俺も」
dialogues.en: "Darn it... What a nice guy I am."
dialogues.text: "Darn it... What a nice guy I am."

dialogues.jp:
ため息ばっかりついて、今度は音夢の相手をす
るために家に入った。
dialogues.en: Sighing, I went inside to be with Nemu.
dialogues.text: Sighing, I went inside to be with Nemu.

dialogues.jp: ◆さくら先生・日曜日◆
dialogues.en: ◆Sakura-sensei on Sunday◆
dialogues.text: ◆Sakura-sensei on Sunday◆

dialogues.jp:
日曜日、さくらが遊びに行こうと来るのだが、
たまには音夢と一緒にいてやりたいと断る。
dialogues.en:
On Sunday, Sakura came to my house to ask me if I would go
somewhere. But I declined her offer because I wanted to be
with Nemu on Sunday at least.
dialogues.text:
On Sunday, Sakura came to my house to ask me if I would go
somewhere. But I declined her offer because I wanted to be
with Nemu on Sunday at least.

dialogues.jp:
やさしいんだね、と言われた後、不思議で困っ
た質問をされる。
dialogues.en:
After she said I was very kind to her, she gave me a queer
question.
dialogues.text:
After she said I was very kind to her, she gave me a queer
question.

dialogues.jp:
「お兄ちゃんの大好きな子がふたりいて、その
　どちらかがいなくなるとして……お兄ちゃん
　が失うほうを選べるとしたら……」
dialogues.en:
"If you had two lovely children and one of them had to go
away, then, which one would you choose?"
dialogues.text:
"If you had two lovely children and one of them had to go
away, then, which one would you choose?"

dialogues.jp:
「その片方が音夢ちゃんだったら、もうひとり
　はどのくらい大切じゃないといけないかな？」
dialogues.en:
"If one of them is Nemu, how important does the other one
have to be for you?"
dialogues.text:
"If one of them is Nemu, how important does the other one
have to be for you?"

dialogues.jp:
俺はなんとなく照れながら、それがお前だった
ら難しい質問だなと答えた。
dialogues.en:
Feeling embarrassed, I answered it would be very difficult
if the other one is Sakura.
dialogues.text:
Feeling embarrassed, I answered it would be very difficult
if the other one is Sakura.
